# STRIVE

> STRIVE (Society for Training Resources and Instructional Value Enhancement) is a
> professional trainer network based in Kochi, Kerala, India. It connects certified
> trainers with colleges, schools, corporate organizations, and CSR initiatives across
> India.

## About

- STRIVE matches pre-screened, certified trainers with educational institutions,
  colleges, corporates, and CSR programs across India.
- Training domains: Soft Skills & Workplace Etiquette, Aptitude & Logical Reasoning,
  Verbal Communication & Public Speaking, Technical & Coding Bootcamps, School
  Empowerment Programs, and Faculty Development Workshops.
- Every trainer undergoes domain evaluation, training demo review, and verification
  checks before joining, plus ongoing Training of Trainers (TOT) upskilling.
- Based in Kochi, Kerala, India; operates across India.

## Pages

- [Home](https://strivesociety.in/): Overview of STRIVE, trainer network, and impact.
- [Membership](https://strivesociety.in/membership): Apply as a certified trainer —
  Soft Skills, Aptitude & Logic, Verbal Communication, or Technical/Coding tracks.
- [Contact](https://strivesociety.in/contact): Reach STRIVE for trainer applications,
  institutional hiring, or CSR partnership inquiries.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Who can become a STRIVE member?
A: Experienced trainers, domain experts, educators, and instructors specializing in
Soft Skills, Aptitude & Logic, Verbal Communication, Technical/Coding, or School
Empowerment modules are welcome to apply for STRIVE membership.

Q: How do institutions hire certified trainers through STRIVE?
A: Colleges, schools, and corporate organizations can contact STRIVE with their
training scope, schedule, and domain requirements. STRIVE matches pre-screened,
certified trainers and manages end-to-end scheduling, feedback, and contracts.

Q: What training domains and modules are covered?
A: Soft Skills & Workplace Etiquette, Aptitude & Logical Reasoning, Verbal
Communication & Public Speaking, Technical & Coding Bootcamps, School Empowerment
Programs, and Faculty Development Workshops.

Q: What are CSR education projects and how can organizations partner?
A: Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) projects deliver skill building, career
readiness, and educational empowerment to schools and underserved communities.
Corporates can sponsor or collaborate with STRIVE to execute verified impact modules.

Q: Is there a membership fee for trainers joining STRIVE?
A: Trainer onboarding begins with a credential review and background verification.
Detailed membership tiers, protection policies, and workshop access details are
shared upon initial profile approval.

Q: How does STRIVE verify trainers and ensure quality standards?
A: Every trainer undergoes domain evaluation, training demo reviews, and verification
checks before joining the network. STRIVE also runs continuous Training of Trainers
(TOT) upskilling workshops to maintain quality standards.
